semantics: Truth is reviewed synthetic shared-product ground truth, not production prevalence or catalogue-wide accuracy; unknown truth is never inferred from a detector.
Expected per-tool state, products and incomplete_products are a separate adapter conformance contract using canonical product IDs.

Native rules use three-valued evidence, Attack as metadata, and cross-response schemas. Missing all responses is incomplete; any missing body term remains unknown unless another decisive term or schema settles the product.

wafw00f preserves Normal/Attack role selection, requests-style repeated-header joining and imperative plugin ordering. An unavailable field access aborts only that plugin as incomplete; later OR branches are not speculatively evaluated.
Status zero means metadata unavailable. Truncation or transport/body-read error makes content unknown but preserved status, reason, headers and cookies remain usable.

Shared comparison times warm named classification only, excluding generic. Full-native all-product results and allocation measurements are separate from shared-tool accuracy and reviewed schema coverage.

Coverage inventory preserves every full-catalogue schema identity and every reviewed fixture identity. Baseline-untested is an inherited inventory, not reviewed accuracy; new/changed rules require positive and negative review links. No automatic truth or lock blessing command exists.

Reason fingerprints are exact case-sensitive literal equality, not regular expressions. Upstream Shieldon has a bracketed literal header key that cannot occur in valid HTTP evidence; its unreachable branch is intentionally not added.

Observed cross-tool disagreement is reported independently of per-tool expected conformance and synthetic truth. Deliberate role, repeated-header, malformed-cookie and empty-header disagreement cases have unknown product truth.

Provenance metadata explicitly classifies inherited fixtures as synthetic conformance. Historical collection/review dates and reviewer identities are unknown; migration does not constitute a new independent review or a real capture.

The 29-product expansion adds source-conformance cases for pkSecurity's boolean differences: native schema 1 is AND and schema 2 is OR; pinned wafw00f 2.4.2 pksec.py uses OR and AND respectively. Their identical response roles isolate this from Attack metadata differences. New cases retain unknown product truth, and both native schemas remain baseline-untested pending human review.

Source inspection for pkSecurity found none of its five content patterns in pre-existing complete bodies. Existing product expectations and truth are retained. Native missing or unavailable bodies leave pkSecurity unknown across the response pool; upstream's first content access leaves it unknown only when Attack is missing or unavailable. The existing known-empty case supplies the complete negative control.
